title: Travel Completed | APPR | INVOL Earlier Flight | Actual < Promise | Not Eligible
description:
AC involuntarily rebooked customer to an EARLIER flight. Customer arrived at 12:00 � 2 hours BEFORE the original promise of 14:00. Since the customer arrived EARLIER than promised, there is no delay (delay cannot be negative). Validates that: (1) DDS treats negative delay (early arrival) as zero, (2) An INVOL change to an earlier flight does NOT create a compensable event � arriving early is not a disruption, (3) The promise remains the original 14:00 (no VOL before the INVOL), and actual 12:00 is before that promise ? no delay. Edge case where INVOL actually benefits the customer.

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger(Adult). Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 424, YUL?YYZ. Promise (14-day): Arrival = 14:00 (no VOL changes before the INVOL). INVOL change: AC rebooked to earlier flight � new arrival 12:00. Actual arrival: 12:00 (on time per INVOL rebooking � 2hrs BEFORE original promise). Delay calculation: 12:00 ? 14:00 = ?2hrs (arrived early) ? net delay = 0. Regime: APPR (domestic).
